pages.text: Precise control reduces refinement time and stabilizes pill formation. This skill improves nearby Alchemy Furnaces.

$(bold)Type:$() Extra Skill$(br)$(bold)Input:$() Press the skill key to enable or disable$(br)$(bold)Cost:$() None$(br2)While enabled, it dynamically changes nearby Alchemy Furnaces: within about 5 blocks, normal skill reduces total cooking time to 50%; when mastered, it reaches about 10 blocks and reduces time to 10%. Leaving range or disabling it restores the original total while preserving proportional progress.
